title: Handsontable codemod version manifest
description: Documentation of versions/<semver>/manifest.json. The validator in src/manifest.mjs is the enforcing copy; test/manifest.test.mjs pins the kind list and the required fields of each kind against this file.

from.description: The version line the migration starts from: "17" for 18.0.0, "18.0" for 18.1.0. A partial version stands for the whole line. It must be below `version`. The lowest `from` of all manifests is the oldest version the tool covers.

status.description: A draft manifest runs only with --include-draft.

url.description: Public URL of the migration guide.

source.description: Repository path of the guide source.

include.description: Files, relative to the version directory, that hold a { "rules": [...] } object. Their rules follow the inline ones.

guide.description: Anchor in the migration guide, without the #.

safe.description: true: the tool applies the rewrite by default. false: the tool never edits code for the rule. It reports manual entries and may leave a TODO comment. Required for every kind except detect and exportRemoved, which only report and take false or no value.

from.description: The module the names were imported from.

exports.description: Name to { to, note } (the name moved to a module or a list of candidate modules, with an optional manual note) or { removed: true, advice }.

fallback.description: Entry for names that `exports` does not list. Same shape as an `exports` entry.

moduleRemoved.description: The module no longer exists. Every namespace import, `export *`, dynamic import, and `require` of it is reported, not only the ones that name an entry of `exports`.

todo.description: For a rule that is not safe: leave a TODO comment on the old import besides the manual entry.

source.description: A module or the list of modules the name was exported from.

toSource.description: The module, or candidates, the new name is imported from when it moves.

note.description: Text of a manual entry added once per file after a rewrite.

todo.description: For a rule that is not safe: leave a TODO comment on the old import besides the manual entry.

from.description: Handsontable.<path> or a list of paths. A * stands for one segment, as in Handsontable.plugins.*.Settings.

to.description: The named export that replaces the member. `name` defaults to the last segment of the path, `source` is a module or a list of candidate modules.

note.description: Text of a manual entry added once per file after a rewrite.

optionKeys.description: Plugin name to option key, or null for a plugin with no option, for the {optionKey} placeholder of the advice.

noKeyAdvice.description: Advice used instead of `advice` for a plugin whose option key is null.

todo.description: For a rule that is not safe: leave a TODO comment on the statement besides the manual entry.

source.description: A module, a list, or a pattern where * stands for one path segment.

optionKeys.description: Plugin name to option key, or null for a plugin with no option, for the {optionKey} placeholder of the advice.

noKeyAdvice.description: Advice used instead of `advice` for a plugin whose option key is null.

context.description: Without it the rule renames a key of Handsontable option objects and wrapper attributes. { "callArg": [method names] } renames it in object-literal arguments of method calls with those names instead.

receiver.description: Rewrite only calls on `x.getPlugin('<key>')` or a variable or this member the file sets from it. Calls on another receiver in a Handsontable file are reported when the argument sets the key.

to.description: Name of the option that sits beside <option>.

report.description: Text of a manual entry added after every move.

todo.description: Leave a TODO comment with the advice where the option stood. Default true.

receiver.description: `any`: the names are unique to Handsontable and are removed on any receiver in a Handsontable file. `instance`: only on a receiver confirmed to be a grid instance. `{ plugin }`: only on `x.getPlugin('<key>')` or a variable or this member the file sets from it.

methods.description: Old method name to its name on the new home.

via.description: The call that reaches the new home, for example { method: getPlugin, args: [undoRedo] }.

properties.description: Property names that become the `via` call itself.

callee.description: Dotted path of the function, rooted at the namespace: Handsontable.helper.sanitize.

arg.description: Index of the argument that replaces the call. Default 0.

bump.description: Package name to target version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). The range keeps the operator the user wrote.

replaced.description: Package name that has no release for the target to the text of a manual entry that names its replacement.

add.description: Packages to add. Each item: name, range, whenFact, onlyIfDependsOn (a package name or an array of names).

reportMissing.description: Packages to report when the package.json does not declare them and, with whenFact, phase 1 found that fact. Never added. Each item: name, optional whenFact, onlyIfDependsOn, and message.

reportPresent.description: Packages to report when the package.json declares them and, with whenFact, phase 1 found that fact. Each item: name, message, optional whenFact and onlyIfDependsOn.

facts.description: Facts to collect from js parts in phase 1. Each item: name and when, one of { import }, { property, withKey? }.

match.description: One matcher object (import, property, call, hook, string, selector, regex, missingOption) with its modifiers, or { anyOf: [...] } or { allOf: [first, ...gates] }. See the detect transform.

files.description: Part kinds the rule reads. The js-only matchers need ["js"].

emitsFact.description: Fact name added when the rule matches in a part.

unlessFileMatches.description: Regular expression on the text of the part. The rule skips a part that matches it.

mergeKey.description: Rules of different versions that share a mergeKey report a spot once: the later rule replaces the earlier one on the same line of the same part.
